parameters.formDescription: Describe what you want to test. The AI generates detailed QA test cases and creates them as Jira issues.

values.placeholder: e.g. VPN / QNAP NAS / Synology / Multicast (IGMP) / API / Web app
Feature, topology and build under test, e.g. IKEv2 reconnection, kill-switch, DNS-leak, wired + wireless clients

parameters.text:
=You are a senior QA engineer specializing in networking, storage and general software testing.
Generate {{ $json.Count || 10 }} detailed, professional QA test cases for the following.

Device / Topic: {{ $json.Device }}
Scope / focus: {{ $json.Scope }}

Where relevant, cover functional, negative, boundary, security, performance, and interoperability testing.
Return ONLY a valid JSON array. No markdown, no code fences, no commentary.
Each element MUST have exactly these keys:
"test_id" (e.g. TC-001), "title", "category" (functional|negative|boundary|security|performance|interoperability), "priority" (High|Medium|Low), "preconditions", "steps" (a numbered, multi-line string), "test_data", "expected_result".
